source: OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0, via Overpass API (tools/fetch-seamarks.mjs)
note: IALA A (Sweden): red to port / green to starboard when entering from seaward. Cardinal colours: N black/yellow, E black/yellow/black, S yellow/black, W yellow/black/yellow. lights[].text is the standard abbreviation, e.g. "Q(3) W 10s". Invented marks (invented: true) are generated harbour-mouth gates for harbours with no real mark nearby (tools/invent-harbour-marks.mjs): the game draws them like real ones, only the chart / debug view shows the flag.
